envelopes.source: YouTube Data API v3 videos.insert (resumable upload); YouTube upload limits: 12 hours / 256 GB; Shorts: ≤ 60 s, square or taller than wide
envelopes.note: Both modes use the same resumable videos.insert call; the mode decides the title tag, the returned URL, and which ceiling is enforced.

envelopes.source: X media upload limits: 140 s of video for standard accounts, 512 MB, 1:2.39-2.39:1; Premium accounts allow longer videos (raise it with x.max_video_duration_seconds)
envelopes.note: No long-form path until the account's real cap is raised; over 140 s is refused, never truncated.

envelopes.source: Meta Reels API: Reels up to 15 minutes, 4 GB
TikTok Content Posting API: video up to 10 minutes, 1 GB
Threads API: video up to 5 minutes (the container fetches it from a public URL)
Graph API /{page-id}/videos: up to 4 hours, 10 GB
Rumble video upload API is partner-gated; limits are reported by the service per plan
envelopes.note: Integration-uncertain: no self-serve developer console, so the manual handoff is the reliable path.
